name: wmkf_appreviewersuggestion-honorarium-eligibility
_comment: Additive lead-PD closeout disposition on one reviewer engagement. Null means no human closeout disposition has been recorded. This field does not authorize payment and must never be substituted for akoya_request.wmkf_authorizationtoremitpaymentflag. Run scripts/preflight-reviewer-closeout-schema.mjs before the creation-only schema applier; an exact manually-created field is an expected no-op.

attributes.description: Lead Program Director disposition for a completed reviewer engagement. This does not authorize payment; Operations and Finance retain final authorization to remit.
